summary.intent: Autonomously run the full GSD post-execute-phase ship loop for cipher-box phase 73 (verify, secure, crypto/privacy review, security review, Nyquist validation, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit CLI, ship, resolve PR reviews) without stopping for user input except on real blockers.
summary.outcome: Verify/secure/validate passed (7/7, SECURED 17/17, 0 gaps); root-caused and fixed a local TEE-worker stack misconfiguration to get SDK E2E to 106/106; found and fixed two real phase-73 bugs (a stale test assertion in ipns-publish-gate.test.ts and a stale-state bug in useSharedNavigationActions.ts); CodeRabbit CLI noise triaged as discard. Commits for the fixes were landing when the transcript ends — ship, PR review resolution, and learnings extraction had not yet run.

repo: tee_key_state is populated by the API's TeeKeyStateService fetching the tee-worker's pubkey at boot (not by the worker itself); if that fetch fails at startup the table stays empty and all tombstone/republish e2e tests fail with 'tee_key_state is empty'.

Local docker stack: cipherbox-mock-ipns-routing claims host port :3001, so cipherbox-tee-worker's container port 3001 gets remapped to host :3002. The API's TEE_WORKER_URL still defaults to :3001, so it silently fetches from the wrong service (mock-ipns-routing, 404) instead of the real worker — must explicitly set TEE_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:3002.

tee-worker endpoints (e.g. /public-key) are gated by `Authorization: Bearer $TEE_WORKER_SECRET` (apps/tee-worker/src/middleware/auth.ts); the host-run API also needs TEE_WORKER_SECRET set to the worker container's matching secret or the pubkey fetch 401s and tee_key_state never seeds.

Phase 73's executor commits already used conventional subjects (`fix(73-08):`, `test(73-01):`) rather than GSD's typical non-conventional `feat 73-08:` style, so the mandatory filter-branch reword step (Step 7) was unnecessary here — check commit subjects before assuming the reword is needed.
resolveIpnsRecord maps HTTP 404 to null but lets 410 fall through to throw (apps/... line ~132) — relevant when reasoning about tombstone propagation on the resolve side of the IPNS gate.

code.finding: Test 20 (WRITE-04) still asserted the pre-phase-73 contract that createAndPublishIpnsRecord throws on a 410 tombstone. Phase 73 changed the function to catch the 410 and return {success:false, tombstoned:true} instead, so publishError stayed undefined and the test failed — this was a stale assertion, not a regression (confirmed no production caller relied on the old throw).

refreshCurrentDepthWriteKey reseeded publishedNode from the cached getSharedFolderState() instead of re-resolving via IPNS first, so on a tombstone/stale-state 'Refresh access' retry it re-derived the key against the same stale node and could never recover. Fixed to mirror the existing restoreToBreadcrumbIndex pattern: call getSdkClient().refreshSharedFolder(currentShareId) (try/catch-ignored) before reseeding.

workflow: Running long background gates (SDK E2E, CodeRabbit CLI, multiple audit agents) in parallel let the orchestrator keep making progress (docker checks, build chain, diff review) instead of idling.
A backgrounded command's summary line ('completed, exit code 0') can be misleading when output is piped — always tail/inspect the actual result file rather than trusting the notification's exit code.

When an e2e failure looks like a regression, systematically ruling out infra (container health, DB state, env var wiring, auth) before touching phase code avoided misdiagnosing a wiring gap as a code bug.

friction: Background task notification reported SDK E2E exit code 0, but the real exit code was 1 (masked by a pipe) — required manually tailing output to catch 3 failing tests.
Diagnosing the TEE E2E failures required a multi-step root-cause chain (container health → DB tee_key_state → port collision → auth secret mismatch) before it was clear phase 73 wasn't at fault.
CodeRabbit CLI raised 2 nits with hallucinated cross-references to nonexistent phases (45–55/79–88) in planning docs — pure noise requiring manual verification to dismiss.
open_items: The crypto/privacy and general-security agents both flagged a non-blocking LOW: publishedParent resolve at client.ts:5674 uses raw resolvePublishedNode, bypassing the ROT-07 gate applied to sibling reads — final disposition (fix/todo/discard) was not resolved before the transcript ends.

Remaining ship-phase steps not yet executed at transcript end: commit the docs/todo changes, conventional PR title + body via gh api PATCH, push, CodeRabbit PR-level review + thread resolution, final green-check report, and /gsd-extract-learnings for 73-LEARNINGS.md.
Two real bugs were fixed inline (stale Test 20 contract, stale-state refreshCurrentDepthWriteKey) but had not yet been referenced in the PR body triage tally described in the ship-phase instructions.
